subject: Blended commit proposal + model-premium and embeddings rate clarification
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@acme.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18 09:12 PDT
Subject: Pricing clarification — per-token tiers and premium model surcharges

Hannah,

Quick question as we scope our pilot: can you send a short note outlining how Redwood handles volume discounts on the hosted API (per-token commits) and how model-specific pricing is applied? Specifically:

- If we commit to a flat token volume per month, how does that map to per-token rates across chat vs embeddings?
- Do you allow a "blended" commit (e.g., commit covers X tokens at standard chat rate, plus a separate bucket for embeddings) or is granularity at model-class level?
- What surcharge do you apply for premium models (we're evaluating rwd-premium-2.7B for some assistant flows)? Can that surcharge be capped for a committed term?

We're trying to compare a pure usage bill vs a 12-mo commit with modest discount bands. Procurement also wants to understand overage billing and whether premium-model usage can be carved out.

Thanks — if easier to call, I can jump on 30m tomorrow.

Tom
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corporation

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-18 13:45 PDT
Subject: Re: Pricing clarification — per-token tiers and premium model surcharges

Tom — thanks for the clear list. High level summary below; I attached our pricing matrix for the math and examples.

1) Commit structure and blended buckets
- We support blended commits: the commitment is expressed in tokens/month and can be mapped to buckets by usage class (chat vs embeddings). For example you can commit 1B tokens/mo as a base (applies to standard chat models) and carve out a smaller embeddings bucket (e.g., 200M tokens/mo) at the agreed embeddings rate.
- At invoice time we apply the committed units first to the corresponding bucket(s); any excess is billed at the applicable overage rate.

2) Model-specific premiums
- We price models in tiers: Standard, Large, Premium. Premium models (e.g., rwd-premium-2.7B) carry a multiplier over the standard chat rate. Typical multiplier range is 1.15–1.40 depending on model family and latency SLO.
- For committed deals we can cap the surcharge (e.g., max +25%) for the term or offer a lower multiplier in exchange for higher commit or longer term.

3) Embeddings vs chat
- Embeddings are metered separately (embedding tokens/units). For commits that include embeddings, we typically offer deeper discounts on embeddings (they're predictable) but require minimum volume.

4) Overage and spike protection
- Overage is billed at the published overage rate (sheet shows stepped overage bands). We can add a negotiated spike-protection clause (soft cap + notifications + emergency burst credits) for enterprise commitments.

Attached: redwood_pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx — you can toggle examples for 6/12/24 month terms.

If you want, I can loop in procurement on my side and propose a 12-mo blended commit example (numbers + proposed contract language). Happy to schedule a 30m tomorrow afternoon.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@acme.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-19 08:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Pricing clarification — per-token tiers and premium model surcharges

Thanks Hannah — attaching procurement so they see the approach. A few follow-ups from procurement side:

- They want a clear example showing: committed tokens, committed embeddings tokens, standard chat rate, premium multiplier, resulting effective blended rate.
- Can you include a clause that caps premium model surcharges to a fixed percentage for the term? Procurement prefers predictability for forecasting.
- Regarding overage: can you confirm whether overage is billed monthly or quarterly? Also curious if you provide a reconciliation credit in case our actual annual run-rate exceeds the committed band by a sustained margin.

If you can send a 12-month example (raw numbers) we can push this quickly through our internal approval.

Tom

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19 10:15 PDT
Subject: Fwd: Acme pricing clarification — proposed counter and notes (internal)

Forwarding Acme thread. Internal notes / proposed approach:

- Baseline ask: propose 12-mo blended commit: 1.2B tokens/month baseline at standard chat rate, plus 250M embeddings tokens/month. That maps to an effective blended rate around $0.00072/token for chat usage (see attached matrix) and $0.00035 per embedding unit.
- Premium model surcharge: offer capped +20% surcharge for rwd-premium family for the 12-mo term. If they want lower cap (e.g., +15%) we push for +18% and require a 15% increase in the committed volume.
- Overage: bill monthly at stepped overage bands; include a reconciliation clause for annual true-up if sustained overage >20% for three consecutive months (credit applies to subsequent quarter). This is a margin-safe compromise that procurement tends to accept.
- Ask Marcus for SOW language and Rishi to confirm finance approvals for the credit policy and revenue recognition.

Attachments: ACME_SOW_draft_v1.docx, redwood_pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx

Thanks — Hannah

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@acme.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>, Alice Ng <alice.ng@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20 16:22 PDT
Subject: Proposal: 12-mo blended commit + capped premium surcharge (summary & next steps)

Tom / team — following our thread and internal alignment, here is a succinct proposal you can share with procurement. If this looks good we will put SOW and DocuSign chain in motion.

Summary terms (commercial):
- Term: 12 months (starts on SOW execution date)
- Commit: 1.2 billion tokens/month allocated as follows:
  - Standard chat models: up to 950M tokens/month at the standard chat committed rate ($0.00075/token)
  - Embeddings: 250M tokens/month at embeddings committed rate ($0.00034/embedding-unit)
- Premium model usage (rwd-premium-* family): surcharge capped at +20% of standard chat committed rate for the duration of the term. Example: standard $0.00075 -> premium capped at $0.00090/token.
- Overage: billed monthly at published overage bands (see attached matrix). Reconciliation credit: if overage exceeds 20% for three consecutive months, we will apply a one-time credit equal to the difference between the overage paid and the pro-rated committed rate for the following quarter (see SOW clause 4.3).
- Spike protection: soft cap notifications at 80/90/100% of commit; emergency burst credits available upon request (limited to 30% of monthly commit per month).

Next steps:
1) Confirm approval in your procurement system and provide target SOW signature date.
2) We will issue SOW + DocuSign (attached draft) and include the pricing matrix.
3) Once executed we’ll schedule a kickoff with solutions engineering to align model placement and KV-cache strategy to control costs.

If you want an alternative: we can run a 6-mo pilot at a slightly higher premium cap (25%) and then convert to 12-mo with retroactive credit; let me know if procurement prefers that path.

Thanks — happy to hop on a call if you want to walk the numbers.

—Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
